items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Did you know Henry Allen? Sure. Did you ever play with Henry Allen? No.

ctx.x: Well, did you ever work with Old Man Allen's brass band?
No. Did you know Henry Allen? Sure. Did you ever play with Henry Allen? No. Did you know Higginbottom? Sure. Did you ever play with Higginbottom?
What about down here, Punch? When you got down? No.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I know his son, but I didn't ever know him. ... I didn't ever get a chance to see him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was before I came back.
I think he was with the Maple Leaf. Yeah, because he used to talk about that. But I think the Maple Leaf broke up then. I think he was with Henry Allen too.
I need to have a picture of him with Henry Allen. Yeah, I think so.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Yeah that's Snagit. That blue that there.

ctx.x: Just put a little more in it. You know what I mean.
Yeah that's Snagit. That blue that there. What do you call him?
Snagit. The first one though was Sugarfoot Stomp. Sugarfoot Stomp.
